A2: Inspect candidate execution, election and pre-election result consumption, timeout handling, and authority transitions. Identify context ownership and unresolved dependencies on vote producers.

A4/A1/A6: Inspect configuration-entry production and ordinary log dispatch together, including persistence outcomes and handoffs to replication. Determine which configuration changes affect commitment consumers and when.

A5/A7: Recover application scheduling, batch filtering, response association, and restore interactions. Compare these observations with the already supplied FSM and BatchingFSM interface statements; leave any truncated control flow unresolved.

A3: Inspect startup snapshot selection, failed restoration handling, and recovered metadata. Identify the retained representation used to resume participation and dependencies on surrounding startup logic.

rationale: Prioritize distinct responsibility areas before deeper dependency tracing. These eight nonoverlapping requests contain 935 previously unread lines and avoid all supplied cached intervals. The reads support candidate question selection, not predetermined obligations or correctness conclusions.
